steps.name: Spirited Tourist
steps.text: Look! You can see the mountain outside!

steps.name: Spirited Tourist
steps.text: My god, it's way too close. Is that what the Kjerags call Karlan? Doesn't matter. It's gorgeous!

steps.name: Trembling Tourist
steps.text: S-Say, can you close the window...?

steps.name: Spirited Tourist
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Trembling Tourist
steps.text: Th-The wind's too strong. I-I'm starting to have trouble even speaking.

steps.name: Spirited Tourist
steps.text: Come on, exaggerating much? It's not that bad, you can take it...

steps.name: Trembling Tourist
steps.text: Really? You seriously don't feel cold at all? Look at you. You barely have pants on—

steps.name: Spirited Tourist
steps.text: Hey, watch what you're saying, you hooligan.

steps.name: Spirited Tourist
steps.text: The tights I'm wearing are thick enough to keep me warm! Not like that lame getup you're wearing!

steps.name: Trembling Tourist
steps.text: Owww... Fine, fine, fine. Whatever you say.

steps.name: Spirited Tourist
steps.text: Hmph, now get in here. I'm about to take a selfie!

steps.name: Trembling Tourist
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Trembling Tourist
steps.text: Hey, did you hear something just now?

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Ladies and gentlemen! Good day! Good day!

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Frightfully sorry for interrupting your leisurely sightseeing! Please head back to your seats for the moment and make way. We—

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Alright, cut it out with the fancy talk! We don't have time for that!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Sorry, everyone! Out of the way!

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Rosalind! That is no way for a lady to speak!

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Eh, eh, Rosalind, not so rough. You're about to tear my sleeve off!

steps.name: Spirited Tourist
steps.text: Uh, what kind of Kjerag tradition is this?

steps.name: Spirited Tourist
steps.text: Should we run up the train like them, too...?

steps.name: Trembling Tourist
steps.text: That can't be a tradition, can it? Sounds so stupid. I'm not doing it.

steps.name: Spirited Tourist
steps.text: Whatever, let's take our selfie!

steps.name: Spirited Tourist
steps.text: Look at the camera! Three... Two...

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: I've never been one for tag.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: I can't say I'm a fan either. Perhaps we can sit down for a nice conversation?

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: You're the guilty ones trying to run.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: And you'd better keep running. Don't stop.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Oh, by the way, the segment coming up in five minutes offers the best views. If you want to take pictures, there is a better opportunity coming up.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Enjoy your trip.

steps.name: Spirited Tourist
steps.text: And who were those people?

steps.name: Trembling Tourist
steps.text: No clue...

steps.name: Trembling Tourist
steps.text: But you might just be right. Maybe Kjerag has some kind of tradition of running laps up and down the train...

steps.name: Trembling Tourist
steps.text: Well, when in Londinium, as the saying goes...

steps.name: Trembling Tourist
steps.text: What's wrong, babe? You've been spacing out for a while.

steps.name: Spirited Tourist
steps.text: My picture! My picture!

steps.name: Trembling Tourist
steps.text: What about it? The lady just now said we should wait another five minutes for better scenery. Might as well listen to her.

steps.name: Spirited Tourist
steps.text: That's not what I'm talking about! Look! I got a picture of that lady's face!

steps.name: Spirited Tourist
steps.text: She looks kinda familiar. Like I've seen her before somewhere...

steps.name: Spirited Tourist
steps.text: But that's not the point! The important thing is her outfit is just so cool!

steps.name: Spirited Tourist
steps.text: I'm going to treasure this picture!

steps.name: Hospitable Villager
steps.text: Let me show you all something.

steps.name: Hospitable Villager
steps.text: This is the famous Kjerag fondue, made with the finest local cheeses to give it its full-bodied flavor. You won't find this taste anywhere outside Kjerag!

steps.name: Curious Tourist
steps.text: Is it really that amazing?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: C'mon! Hurry up!

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: W-Wait, Rosalind... *cough*!

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Pardon me, ladies and gentlemen. The fondue's taste is fine indeed, but I recommend adding some pepper for a richer flavor—!

steps.name: Hospitable Villager
steps.text: Wh-Who was that?

steps.name: Hospitable Villager
steps.text: Again?!

steps.name: Curious Tourist
steps.text: So is this how train trips go in Kjerag? It's just like my friends told me. Very unique.

steps.name: Curious Tourist
steps.text: Man, this is something else with pepper! I love it!

steps.name: Kjerag Villager
steps.text: They're all here. I caught 'em all!

steps.name: Kjerag Villager
steps.text: Thanks to all of you, I finally caught every last fowlbeast. I don't even know how to begin to show my appreciation...

steps.name: Conductor
steps.text: Make sure your sacks are tied tight this time, old man.

steps.name: Conductor
steps.text: I'll pretend this never happened... but only just this once. Remember, no pets allowed on our trains!

steps.name: Conductor
steps.text: This can never happen again!

steps.name: Kjerag Villager
steps.text: Yes, of course. Of course.

steps.name: Kjerag Villager
steps.text: O-Oh, young'un, what's the rush?

steps.name: Conductor
steps.text: M-Ma'am! Please don't run on the train!

steps.name: Kjerag Villager
steps.text: Hey! You, with the funny hat! Watch... it!

steps.name: Kjerag Villager
steps.text: Oh no! My fowlbeasts! My fowlbeasts got loose again!

steps.name: Annoyed Tourist
steps.text: What the hell is it with these blind boxes? I'm not pulling the limited one at all!

steps.name: Annoyed Tourist
steps.text: Just one more... Just one more try...!

steps.name: Annoyed Tourist
steps.text: Hey, watch it, morons! You'll break my blind boxes...

steps.name: Annoyed Tourist
steps.text: Ahh! I-It's the limited one!

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: This is the end of the line.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: The last car.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Let's call it quits with this game of chase?

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Madam, you've won. The outcome is all but certain.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: I hope we can...

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: You talk too much.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: I don't have time.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Don't worry, Trilby Asher. I won't forget that you want to talk.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: I'll be back later to have a one-on-one chat with you.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Now.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Out, or I'll get you out.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: A-Ahem.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: H-Hey, lady! I'm over here.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: *cough*, *spit*. All this dust all on the ground... So, did you need me for something?

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: It's not you that I'm looking for.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: But there's no one else here...

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Ouch!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: (Don't move!)

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Enough of this charade.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Wh-What charade? Y-You've got it all wrong!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: (Eh, quiet down, will you? I'm trying to keep you out of sight!)
(D-Don't pull my hair!)

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: You're from Rhodes Island?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Huh? I am... You know about Rhodes Island?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Um, are you one of the friends the Doctor made on Rhodes Island's last trip here?

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: A friend? No, I'm not.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Enough. I don't have time to chat.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Show yourself before my patience runs out.
(Forget it, young lady. Just let me out!)

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Haah...!

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: I'm touched by the fact that you would go to such lengths to help me, Rosalind, but wasn't that a bit too cruel of you...?

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Eek... My hair... my moustache.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Finally.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: What? So you two know each other?

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: A-Ahem.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: I wouldn't say we know each other. We've merely met a few times.

spans.text: each other. We've merely met a few times.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Madam Degenbrecher, it's been a while. I must've rather embarrassed myself.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Save the pleasantries.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Craigavon, Leone from the mountain needs to see you, urgently.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Leones...? See me?

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Hold on, it's Leones who's looking for me, not you...?

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: He asked me to come find you. That's all.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Why is he so eager to see me?

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Now that you mention it, I seem to have forgotten something... Hmm...

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: You forgot Lily is still waiting for you.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: ...Right, Lily!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Who's Lily... No way, you forgot your mistress?

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Mistress—?!

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: No, not a mistress. *cough*—

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: ...Lord Viscount, you may well damage Victoria's image if you conduct yourself in this way.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: If the Viscountess and your daughter were to learn about this...

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Whoa, what a scumbag.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Hold on! Ahem, dammit, Bloody Asher! It's not what you think!

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Lily is—
Ladies and gentlemen, we will soon be arriving at our terminus—
Lake Silberneherze Station.
Please be sure to take all your belongings with you and alight via the exits in the front and back of each car in an orderly fashion.
Thank you for riding the Saintess Express.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: You haven't wasted too much time.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: But you'd best climb the mountain and find Leones as soon as you get off the train. He's waiting for you.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Maybe we should split up here. Mamochka wouldn't like me traveling with you.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: No, *cough*, Lily—

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: —Lily's not human!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: You're even going to badmouth her like that?!

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: No, no, no, no. Pff, even I'm cracking up now. Oh, my chest hurts.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Lily's a burdenbeast.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: A burdenbeast.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: I see.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: ...Did I not mention it before?

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Trilby Asher, would you stop playing dumb!

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Do you expect me to believe your spies have never reported on my actions in Kjerag?

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Sorry, but the name of the burdenbeast you nursed back to health is not important enough for me to remember.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: ...So, he's not a scumbag, and he's not in danger?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: I thought it was a life-or-death thing, what with us getting chased and all that.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: I... *sigh*! Rosalind, this has to do with my reputation!

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: How much more time do you want to waste?

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Don't just stand there like an idiot.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: The train is entering the station.
